title: Hill Giant Behemoth
html:
A level 25 Hill Giant that attacks with crush (melee).

Fighting it

Weak burnfreezeshockcrush   Resists slash

A weakness adds 30% damage and a resistance takes 30% off (the game's own rule).

Reagent: Giants Knucklebone (infuses an enchant). A small chance on any kill, far better from elites. Reforging

Drops

Observed drops
Normal loot
Gold Coin3 drops
Percentages are of the corpses whose loot the collector recorded, so kills you did not loot are not counted.
